AI把一个人能做的事放大了好几倍。查资料、写代码、做内容、跑分析，都不再需要一整: AI has multiplied what one person can do several times over. Looking things up, writing code, making content, running analyses: none of it needs a whole team any more. For the first time, it is realistic for one person to do research, start a company, write and invest, all at once.
但精力没有随着能力放大。一天里真正清醒的时间还是有限的，想做的许多事南辕北辙，哪: But our energy has not grown with our abilities. A day still holds only so many truly clear-headed hours, and many of the things you want to do pull in opposite directions. Hand them to AI and the tasks get done, but AI cannot grow for you: understanding a paper, thinking a product through, mastering a craft — each of these needs a human being to take part.

现在的personal agent专注于解放劳动力，告诉你哪些事Agent可以代: Today's personal agents are built to free up labor. They tell you which jobs an agent can take off your hands; they take your work apart but never put it back together. They don't tell you when to do what, how to become better at what you do, or how your different pieces of work can strengthen one another.

It starts from your energy rhythm and the real progress of each track, then decides what to hand to AI and what to keep for you, and puts what stays with you into the hours when you are at your best.
